description: This file defines a command-line command 'DoctorCommand' for a Swift project, which checks speech recognition authorization status, loads configuration, and enumerates available microphone devices. It uses the Commander library for CLI parsing, and interacts with system speech and AVFoundation APIs.

classes.name: DoctorCommand
classes.description: A command-line tool command that checks speech permissions, configuration validity, and available microphones.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously checks speech recognition authorization, loads configuration, and lists microphone devices.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Computes a URL from the provided configuration path option.
